1000 GRID · CREATIVITY · IMAGINE BEYOND THE EXISTING
Creativity is the first value of the currency: the ability to see what does not exist yet and make it real.
The 1000 note states one rule, turn 45° and grow by √2, and repeats it until the form leaves the page.
The grid is not a limit on the idea. It is the ground the idea departs from.
Ten squares share one corner; each is turned 45° and grown by √2, drawn in a pale tint.
The half of each square that nests in the next is a flat multiply of the two inks.
Every far corner lies on r = u√2·e^0.44φ: a curve from straight edges.
Seventy-two rotated ellipses ring the GRID module: the guilloché, kept small.
Amount and issuer under the numerals, with registration square and tactile dots.
Origin O on a grid vertex.
FLAT-COLOUR SEPARATION · ONE PLATE PER ROLE
PROMISES TO PAY THE BEARER ON DEMAND
THE VALUE OF ONE THOUSAND GRID
